description: Offline package startup boundaries. tools/offline/package.py points the Store exe's original IAT slots for ws2_32 (socket/connect/send/sendto/accept/getaddrinfo/gethostbyname), winhttp, xcurl, kernel32 (LoadLibrary*/GetProcAddress/CreateProcess*), ole32 CoCreateInstance, shell32 ShellExecuteA, advapi32 Event* and the CRT system/_popen at recon.dll failure adapters (57 redirects). LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress wrappers refuse the GDK runtime, HTTP and socket modules by name. Slot addresses unchanged. tools/offline/build_dll.py builds recon.dll at the fixed base 0x180000000 with the T7OfflineDllMain attach guard. Not run on native Windows yet.
tests: tools/offline/wine_run.py (bounded Wine run, all IP sockets blocked); manifest.json records every redirect and the exe/dll hashes

description: The offline package replaces XGameRuntimeInitialize (142920308: xor ecx,ecx; jmp 14291FA64) with recon.dll T7OfflineGameRuntimeInitialize (enhanced/offline/gdk.cpp), which reports success without loading xgameruntime.dll. WinMain (1423EA4D0) treats a failed init as fatal ("XGameRuntime failed with error code %d", observed error 0x89240101 = runtime DLL not found). The GDK runtime stays unloaded, so later GDK calls still fail through the original layer; no user/licence/service result is fabricated. NOTE: this is a .text byte patch and is a candidate for the anti-tamper interaction under investigation (docs/native-launch.md).
tests: manifest.json entry bytes; Wine run reaches the game window

description: The Store port's crash reporter never reports: its only entry returns false without reading or calling anything, so neither the Google Analytics event (1423B87C0, with the HKLM HardwareSurvey machine GUID) nor the .gltn report and CrashUploader.exe launch (1423B8BA0, with the machine GUID and volume id) ever happen. The minidump writer (1423F1F80) still writes the dump locally; Com_Error_'s signature/exception hook (1423B9F70) is unchanged. Fixes B0006. Faithful 1423B9DE0 verified first (matches).

description: Demonware's UDP sockets never reach the network: create returns -1 (socket creation failed), getHostByName finds no address without a lookup, bind and sendTo report BD_NET_INVALID_HANDLE for -1 and BD_NET_ERROR otherwise, receiveFrom reports BD_NET_INVALID_HANDLE or BD_NET_WOULD_BLOCK. No Winsock call, log line or statistics update. close stays faithful. Cuts Demonware's datagrams (lobby, matchmaking, NAT traversal, QoS, TURN relays) and its DNS lookups; its TCP stream sockets and HTTP are separate (docs/network.md section 1). Faithful versions verified first (all seven match).

functions: BlackOps3_MSStore 142D171E0, 142D172C0 bdPlatformStreamSocket::create; 142D17050 connect; 142D16EC0 checkSocketException; 142D172D0, 142D173A0 isWritable; 142D17530 receive; 142D176F0 send (enhanced/libs/DemonWareGDK/bdPlatform/bdPlatformSocket/bdPlatformStreamSocket-xboxone.cpp)
description: Demonware's TCP sockets never reach the network: create returns -1, connect BD_NET_ERROR, checkSocketException true, isWritable false (status BD_NET_NOT_CONNECTED), send and receive BD_NET_INVALID_HANDLE for -1 and BD_NET_NOT_CONNECTED otherwise. No Winsock call, log line or statistics update; close stays faithful. Cuts Demonware's lobby and auth connections. Faithful versions verified first (all nine match).

Demonware's HTTP worker never opens a WinHTTP session: initializeWinHTTP returns false without logging or calling WinHTTP, which is what the faithful method does while the network is not ready. The worker thread (142D151C0) then keeps waiting and never takes a request, so no Demonware HTTPS request (auth, Umbrella, UNO, content streaming) is made. Faithful version verified first (matches).

libHttpClient never begins an HTTP request or a WebSocket connection: HttpCallPerformAsync and WebSocketConnectAsync return HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_NETWORK_UNREACHABLE) without allocating, starting an XAsync operation or touching XCurl, so no Xbox services API request (presence, social, session directory, title storage) is sent. The Xbox Live real-time activity WebSocket (wss://rta.xboxlive.com/connect) is therefore never opened. Faithful versions verified first (both match).

Havok's Visual Debugger never opens its server: serve does nothing, so no socket is created, bound to every interface or listened on (the Store build serves on TCP 25001 from the first level load with navigation volumes). The visual debugger object is still created. Fixes B0004. Faithful version verified first (matches).

r_refreshRate accepts 1..1000 Hz instead of 1..240 (B0012), so first-run detection, the menu and the console can set a >240 Hz mode and the fullscreen swap chain selects it; com_maxfps already stops at 1000. Default (60) and every other registration unchanged.

The settings menu lists the refresh rates of every mode of the chosen size, not only those among the first 128 modes (B0013); still highest first, still at most 128 entries. Identical to the original for lists of up to 128 modes.

Mouse aim in MW2019 units: one count turns the view by m_mouseSensitivity * 0.0066 degrees (default 1.5, 0.01-100), in hip fire and ADS, at any FOV and speed: no FOV tangent, weapon ADS sensitivity, acceleration, m_filter or m_mouseFilter (B0016-B0018). CL_MouseMove is unchanged and still multiplies by m_yaw/m_pitch, so at their default 0.022 the rate is exact, the menu vertical sensitivity (m_pitch) stays a multiplier and its sign still inverts.

CL_MouseMove turns the view in double precision: per local client the pitch and yaw are kept as doubles across frames (taken again from the float angles whenever something else changed them) and the turn and the game's speed caps are computed in double, so the same movement split over more frames ends at the same angle and a far-wound yaw keeps sub-ulp movement (B0050). Everything else, including aim assist and the command's mouse amounts, is the original.

The FOV setting cg_fov_default accepts 60-120 (MW2019's range; the original stops at 65, B0021). It is already MW2019's unit, the horizontal FOV at 16:9, default 80. Every other registration in Dvar_Init unchanged. The menu slider is Lua in the fastfiles and keeps its range; config.ini "FOV" and the console reach 60.

Hip fire shows exactly the set FOV (B0020): after CG_CalcFOVfromLens, when the view comes from the lens with depth of field off, tanHalfFovY gets back (1 - fWeaponPosFrac) * 7/500 (focus at infinity), tanHalfFovX keeps the aspect and the stored FOV moves by the same angle. Fully aimed down sights, depth of field on, the cg_drawMinimap lens and fixed scripted-camera FOVs are the original. Reaches the decoder, CG_CalcFOVfromLens and Dvar_GetBool through the exe (tools/recon/include/t7_exe_call.h).
